descripcion: ReDantotsu is a Remake version of the original Dantotsu app. It is built on a foundation that has been tested and works well. ReDantotsu features a new user interface, MyAnimeList rating integration, Liquid Glass theme, etc. This is the best way to keep track of your anime and your manga.
